result.quote: If we say, ‘Let us go into the city,’ we will die there from the famine in the city; but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live; if they kill us, we will die.
result.reason: Verse 7:4 directly gives the stated rationale: remaining outside or entering the famine-stricken city meant death, while surrendering to the Arameans offered a possibility of survival. No materially different motive is supported. The edited question is natural and preserves the original focus on why the men went to the Arameans.
